preconditions.description: The input integer n must be a multiple of 4 and within the range 4 to 1000.

postconditions.expression: all(len(row) == n for row in grid)
postconditions.description: Each row in the grid must have exactly n elements.

postconditions.expression: all(all(0 <= x < n**2 for x in row) for row in grid)
postconditions.description: All elements in the grid must be integers from 0 to n^2 - 1.

postconditions.expression: len(set(x for row in grid for x in row)) == n**2
postconditions.description: All integers from 0 to n^2 - 1 must appear exactly once in the grid.

postconditions.expression: all(xor_row == xor_col for xor_row in row_xors for xor_col in col_xors)
postconditions.description: The XOR of all elements in each row must be equal to the XOR of all elements in each column.
